runtime.scope: Unchanged original full package; two geometry helper tests only. No synthesized native events, app window launch, monitor lifecycle or screenshot checks.

findings: ClickOutsideMonitor installs local left/right mouse monitor only while active and attached to window, ignores other windows, dispatches callback asynchronously after rechecking active flag. Store removes existing monitor on restart and deinit/dismantle. Lifecycle read, not executed by two point-containment tests.

MediaThumbnailLoader checks requestedItemID and cancellation after awaited load to avoid publishing different-item stale result. Same-item-ID content/thumbnail changes do not by themselves change task(id:item.id); no identity-change runtime control here. Cache backend not reviewed by this file read.

VideoCardView displays percent score with explanatory help, evidence text, dimensions/duration and checkbox state. Rendering/help accessibility correctness not established merely by compilation/source.
Toolbar custom capsule hover/press style and popover toggle are presentation code. No toolbar hitbox, disabled-to-enabled hover reset or event behavior qualification.
No external actions invoked or real media modified. Five files actually whole-read and pinned hashes verified; no production/library speedup or full repository credit.
